What are we exporting when we say 'Koshien to Asia'?

Asia Koshien is not an Asian championship played at Koshien Stadium. It began in Jakarta in 2024 and tries to recreate one function Koshien has in Japan: a dream stage young players want to reach. Looking at its growth from 8 to 14 teams, its rituals and cheering, localization problems, business model, and the much older colonial-era history linking Koshien with Asia, the key question changes from 'How Japanese is it?' to 'Whose tournament can it become?'
